2.content: When evaluating a possible move, add a positive bonus proportional to the reduction in Manhattan distance to the goal compared to the current state ONLY if the move does not land on a hole or increase adjacent holes; larger distance reductions yield larger bonuses, but safety overrides this bonus. Rate moves that land directly on a hole as -1000 (immediate failure, no teleport or positive bonus). Heavily penalize (-50 or more) moves that increase the number of adjacent (Manhattan distance 1) hole cells in the resulting state, overriding any goal-distance bonuses.

3.content: When rating moves, give a modest positive incentive to actions that break a recent back-and-forth pattern. If no safe distance-reducing moves exist, allow moves that increase Manhattan distance with reduced penalties.
